keywords: EIP-8250 改为 nonce key 集合
EIP-8130 委托账户创建与免 nonce 重放标识

summary: soispoke 把 EIP-8250 从单个 keyed nonce 扩展为有界的 nonce key 集合，当天提交并合并。chunter-cb 为 EIP-8130 提交委托账户创建草案，并定义与签名无关的免 nonce 重放标识。Vitalik 发文探讨以期权而非 CDP 和清算为基础构建指数跟踪资产。koeppelmann 披露 Gnosis Pay 与 delay module 相关的攻击，Gnosis 将承担全部用户损失。

items.title: EIP-8250：支持 nonce key 集合
items.note: （soispoke）提交并合并：从单个 keyed nonce `(nonce_key, nonce_seq)` 改为有界的 key 集合 `(nonce_keys, nonce_seq)`。
items.title_en: EIP-8250: add support for nonce key sets
items.note_en: (soispoke), submitted and merged: moves from a single keyed nonce `(nonce_key, nonce_seq)` to a bounded key set `(nonce_keys, nonce_seq)`.

items.title: EIP-8130：委托账户创建
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交，作为讨论草案：create 条目除了放置字节码，还可以直接创建 EIP-7702 委托账户，不新增条目类型。
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted as a discussion draft: the create entry can produce an EIP-7702 delegated account in addition to placed bytecode, without a new entry type.

items.title: EIP-8130：定义与签名无关的免 nonce 重放标识
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交：规范原先只写“按交易哈希去重”，而标准交易哈希会承诺 `sender_auth` 与 `payer_auth`，无法实现每个窗口只有一笔逻辑交易的目标。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: define a signature invariant, nonce free replay identifier
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted: the spec only said "deduplicate by transaction hash", but the standard transaction hash commits to `sender_auth` and `payer_auth`, which does not achieve one logical transaction per window.

items.note_en: 23:01; factories such as Arachnid, ERC-2470 and CreateX sit at the same address across chains today thanks to Nick's method of a presigned transaction.

keywords_en: EIP-8250 moves to nonce key sets
EIP-8130 delegated account creation and a nonce free replay identifier
Vitalik on index assets built on options instead of debt
summary_en: soispoke extended EIP-8250 from a single keyed nonce to a bounded set of nonce keys, submitted and merged the same day. chunter-cb submitted a delegated account creation draft for EIP-8130 and defined a signature invariant replay identifier for nonce free transactions. Vitalik wrote about building index tracking assets on options rather than CDPs and liquidations. koeppelmann disclosed a hack related to Gnosis Pay and the delay module, with Gnosis covering all user losses.
